text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornInAmericanCity(x) ::: x is born in an American City.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Title(x, y) ::: x has title y.
WrittenIn(x, y) ::: x is written in year y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
FamilyHistory ::: the book Family History.
FamilySecrets ::: the podcast Family Secrets.
DaniShapiro ::: Dani Shapiro.
Boston ::: Boston.

Premises:
Podcast(not_a_novel) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
BornInAmericanCity(DaniShapiro) → American(DaniShapiro) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
Novel(x) ∧ Book(y) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x) → NovelWriter(x) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Author(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro authored Family History.
Book(FamilyHistory) ::: Family History is a book.
WrittenIn(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History was written in 2003.
Created(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
Title(FamilySecrets, "Family Secrets") ::: Family Secrets has title "Family Secrets".
Boston ::: Boston is an American city.
BostonCity ::: Boston is a city.

Conclusion:
NovelWriter(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
